headers: 8. Response packaging: May suppliers place the complete A–N response and supporting materials in Response Attachments, with summaries in Attributes 5 and 6? Are there page or file-size limits?

The purpose of this RFI is to understand available solution capabilities and service models. Additional scope details may be provided in a future solicitation, if issued.
Is the scope limited to the approximately 242,214 manually processed invoices, or does it also include the approximately 163,810 invoices received through EDI and GHX?

For Fiscal Year 2026, a total of 406,024 purchase order invoices were processed (242,214 standard invoices and 163,810 EDI and GHX invoices). Standard purchase order invoices are in scope of this project, EDI and GHX invoices are not in scope.
